BundleRole.description: Product role counted by the bundle rule, e.g. bath, toilet, furniture (since 1.19.0).

key.description: Stable role key referenced by MasterCategoryRecord.bundle_role and MasterProductBundle.role; a product whose key is not listed here is an accessory
key.title: Key

min_price.description: Minimum unit price in KZT for a product to count for this role; cheaper products count for no role (accessory) but still get the cart discount
min_price.title: Min Price

name.description: Role name shown to the customer, Russian
name.title: Name

name_kk.description: Role name in Kazakh; null — show the Russian one
name_kk.title: Name Kk

BundleRole.title: BundleRole

BundleRules.description:
Published bundle-discount rule (since 1.19.0).

Bundle discount does not stack with a promo (MasterProductRecord.promo): a product on promo
keeps its promo price. Savings are shown in KZT.

enabled.description: Master switch; false — the storefront shows no bundle discount at all
enabled.title: Enabled

roles.description: Roles counted by the rule, in display order
roles.title: Roles

tiers.description: Discount steps sorted by roles ascending
tiers.title: Tiers

BundleRules.title: BundleRules

BundleTier.description: One discount step of the bundle rule (since 1.19.0).

percent.description: Discount percent applied to the whole cart; on each line it is capped by MasterProductRecord.bundle.max_percent
percent.title: Percent

roles.description: Minimum number of different roles in the cart for this step, e.g. 2, 3, 4 (4 means '4 or more'); the step with the largest roles not above the cart count applies
roles.title: Roles

BundleTier.title: BundleTier

MasterBundleSetRecord.description:
Ready-made set of products assembled by the content manager in the inventory admin (since 1.19.0).

Published only while every product of the set is in stock; the set price is the bundle
quote of its products under BundleRules.

image.description: Absolute public image URL; null — use product photos
image.title: Image

product_ids.description: Product ids (MasterProductRecord.id) in display order, one unit each
product_ids.title: Product Ids

slug.description: Stable URL slug of the set, owned by PIM
slug.title: Slug

translations.description: Set text translations keyed by language code, currently only 'kk'
translations.title: Translations

MasterBundleSetRecord.title: MasterBundleSetRecord

MasterBundleSetTranslation.description: Translation of bundle set texts into one storefront language (since 1.19.0).
MasterBundleSetTranslation.title: MasterBundleSetTranslation

MasterCategoryCompanion.description: Category whose products complement products of another category (since 1.21.0).

category_id.description: MasterCategoryRecord.id of the companion category, with its descendants
category_id.title: Category Id

relation_type.description: 'REQUIRED_COMPONENT' — needed to install the product, 'RECOMMENDED' — complements it
relation_type.title: Relation Type

MasterCategoryCompanion.title: MasterCategoryCompanion

MasterCategoryRecord.description: Category (taxonomy node) as exported by inventory for storefronts.

bundle_role.description: Bundle role key (BundleRole.key) set on this category itself; null — not set here, the role may be inherited from a parent category. Resolved roles are published in MasterProductRecord.bundle.role. Consumers must treat an unknown key as an accessory (since 1.19.0)
bundle_role.title: Bundle Role

companions.description: Companion categories already resolved with inheritance from parent categories, ordered by priority; attribute filters are applied by PIM and not published (since 1.21.0)
companions.title: Companions

cutout.description: Public CDN URL of a transparent 3D render of a typical product of the category: no background, about 1:1, trimmed to the edges, WebP or PNG with alpha; uploaded by the content manager in the inventory admin, shared by all languages. null — not uploaded, the storefront falls back to photo (since 1.20.0)
cutout.title: Cutout

previous_slugs.description: Former slugs of this category; storefront answers them with 301 to the current slug (since 1.13.0)
previous_slugs.title: Previous Slugs

slug.description: URL slug owned by PIM (since 1.3.0); it is not changed when the category is renamed, the admin may change it manually, former values are kept in previous_slugs (since 1.13.0)
slug.title: Slug

substitute_group.description: Resolved (inherited) key of the group of categories that replace each other, e.g. 'sink', 'mirror'; null — the category substitutes only itself (since 1.21.0)
substitute_group.title: Substitute Group

translations.description: Category text translations keyed by language code, currently only 'kk' (since 1.7.0)
translations.title: Translations

MasterCategoryRecord.title: MasterCategoryRecord

MasterCategoryTranslation.description: Translation of category texts into one storefront language (since 1.7.0).

is_outdated.description: True when the Russian source text changed after this translation was made
is_outdated.title: Is Outdated

status.description: 'machine' — draft translated by Claude, 'reviewed' — checked by a human
status.title: Status

MasterCategoryTranslation.title: MasterCategoryTranslation

MasterCharacteristicRecord.description: Key-value characteristic of a master product.

code.description: Stable attribute code from the PIM dictionary, e.g. 'width', 'color' (since 1.4.0)
code.title: Code

highlight.description: Position (1-4) in the key facts shown under the price; None means not a key fact (since 1.9.0)
highlight.title: Highlight

numeric_value.description: Numeric form of the value for numeric attributes (since 1.4.0)
numeric_value.title: Numeric Value

section.description: Storefront product page section: 'dimensions', 'material' (material and color), 'installation' (installation and connection) or 'features' (since 1.9.0)
section.title: Section

translations.description: Characteristic translations keyed by language code, currently only 'kk' (since 1.7.0)
translations.title: Translations

unit.description: Unit of measurement of the value, e.g. 'cm' (since 1.4.0)
unit.title: Unit

values.description: Separate options of a multi-select attribute; filled only for multi-select, value stays the options joined with ', ' (since 1.10.0)
values.title: Values

MasterCharacteristicRecord.title: MasterCharacteristicRecord

MasterCharacteristicTranslation.description: Translation of one product characteristic into one storefront language (since 1.7.0).

is_outdated.description: True when the Russian source of any part (name, unit, value option) changed after translation
is_outdated.title: Is Outdated

status.description: 'machine' — draft translated by Claude, 'reviewed' — checked by a human; 'reviewed' only when the name, the unit and every value option are reviewed
status.title: Status

value.description: Translated value in the same format as MasterCharacteristicRecord.value: options joined with ', ', number with unit, 'Иә'/'Жоқ' for booleans; None — value is not translated, storefront shows the Russian one
value.title: Value

values.description: Translated options of a multi-select attribute, same order and count as MasterCharacteristicRecord.values; None for other attribute types (since 1.10.0)
values.title: Values

MasterCharacteristicTranslation.title: MasterCharacteristicTranslation

MasterProductBundle.description:
Bundle-discount data of a product (since 1.19.0).

Retail data: not exposed to partners. The storefront computes the bundle discount itself
from BundleRules, because the cart lives only in the browser.

max_percent.description: Maximum bundle discount percent allowed on this product. Computed by inventory from the product margin and the min_margin of its price rule; 0 for excluded products and products without a purchase price. The cost price is never published, only this cap
max_percent.title: Max Percent

role.description: Bundle role key (BundleRole.key) of the product, already resolved by PIM with inheritance from parent categories, so consumers need not walk the category tree. null — the product has no role (accessory). Consumers must treat a key missing from BundleRules.roles as an accessory: it counts for no role but still gets the discount of the cart
role.title: Role

MasterProductBundle.title: MasterProductBundle

MasterProductPromo.description:
Active storefront promo of a product (since 1.17.0).

Present only while the promo is active. MasterProductRecord.price is then the promo
price the customer pays; compare_at_price is the regular retail price shown struck through.
Retail data: not exposed to partners.

compare_at_price.description: Regular retail price before the promo, always greater than the record price
compare_at_price.title: Compare At Price

name.description: Campaign name shown to the customer, e.g. 'Наурыз'; null for a single-product promo
name.title: Name

note.description: Short customer-facing note, e.g. clearance reason 'повреждена упаковка'
note.title: Note

slug.description: URL-safe campaign slug for grouping products on the storefront promo page
slug.title: Slug

translations.description: Promo text translations keyed by language code, currently only 'kk'
translations.title: Translations

type.description: 'sale' — dated promo, single product or part of a named campaign (name/slug set); 'clearance' — markdown of a damaged or last unit, lasts until sold out. Consumers must treat unknown values as a generic promo
type.title: Type

until.description: UTC time when the promo ends; null for open-ended promos (clearance). After it the storefront must show the regular price until the next sync
until.title: Until

MasterProductPromo.title: MasterProductPromo

MasterProductPromoTranslation.description: Translation of promo texts into one storefront language (since 1.17.0).
MasterProductPromoTranslation.title: MasterProductPromoTranslation

MasterProductRecord.description: Master product record as exported by inventory for storefronts.

bundle.description: Bundle-discount role and cap; null — the product takes no part in the bundle discount (e.g. rules are off or the producer predates 1.19.0) (since 1.19.0)

category_slug.description: Stable URL slug of the product category (owned by PIM, since 1.3.0)
category_slug.title: Category Slug

cost_price.description: Cost price. Not published by PLP; kept for v1.x compatibility
cost_price.title: Cost Price

merged_ids.description: IDs of duplicate products merged into this one; storefront answers their id URLs with 301 to this product. Slugs of merged duplicates are added to previous_slugs (since 1.16.0)
merged_ids.title: Merged Ids

name.description: Resolved product name (PIM name, else base name)
name.title: Name

previous_slugs.description: Former slugs of this product; storefront answers them with 301 to the current slug (since 1.5.0)
previous_slugs.title: Previous Slugs

price_updated_at.description: UTC time since which the current retail price is in effect; set by PIM whenever the price changes, null when unknown (since 1.11.0)
price_updated_at.title: Price Updated At

promo.description: Active promo; null when the product is sold at the regular price (since 1.17.0)

related.description: Linked products: manual links first in the order the manager set them, then generated ones by score descending (since 1.21.0); the linked product may be absent from the export (out of stock, not public) (since 1.8.0)
related.title: Related

seo_description.description: SEO meta description generated by PIM (since 1.4.0)
seo_description.title: Seo Description

seo_title.description: SEO meta title generated by PIM (since 1.4.0)
seo_title.title: Seo Title

slug.description: Product URL slug built by PIM from pim_name when the admin saves the card (since 1.5.0)
slug.title: Slug

stock.description: Stock status label, e.g. 'в наличии' or 'нету'
stock.title: Stock

stock_quantity.description: Real available quantity (quantity - reserve - quarantine, min 0)
stock_quantity.title: Stock Quantity

translations.description: Product text translations keyed by language code, currently only 'kk' (since 1.6.0)
translations.title: Translations

MasterProductRecord.title: MasterProductRecord

MasterProductRelation.description:
Link from a master product to another product, set by the content manager in PIM (since 1.8.0)
or generated by the PIM compatibility rules (since 1.21.0).

kind.description: Who created the link: 'manual' — the content manager, 'rule' — the PIM compatibility generator from the category companion matrix; null — manual (producer predates 1.21.0) (since 1.21.0)
kind.title: Kind

reason.description: Codes of why the generator matched the pair: 'same_width', 'same_series', 'same_finish', 'same_color', 'same_brand', 'fits_length', 'price_tier'. Consumers ignore unknown codes (since 1.21.0)
reason.title: Reason

relation_type.description: 'REQUIRED_COMPONENT' — needed to install or use the product (e.g. a siphon for a sink), 'RECOMMENDED' — goes well with it, 'COLLECTION_PAIR' — item of the same collection
relation_type.title: Relation Type

score.description: PIM relevance 0..1 = link weight x attribute compatibility; manual links get 1.0; null — not scored (producer predates 1.21.0) (since 1.21.0)
score.title: Score

MasterProductRelation.title: MasterProductRelation

MasterProductTranslation.description: Translation of product texts into one storefront language (since 1.6.0).

is_outdated.description: True when the Russian source text changed after this translation was made
is_outdated.title: Is Outdated

status.description: 'machine' — draft translated by Claude, 'reviewed' — checked by a human
status.title: Status

MasterProductTranslation.title: MasterProductTranslation

SearchHit.description: One ranked product of a search response (since 1.22.0).

match.description: Why the product was found: exact — SKU / article; lexical — words of the query; semantic — meaning only (synonyms, other language); hybrid — both
match.title: Match

score.description: Relevance, higher is better; comparable only within one response
score.title: Score

SearchHit.title: SearchHit

mode.description: hybrid — words and meaning; lexical — words only (semantic part unavailable or not needed)
mode.title: Mode
